candidate_ref: current customization-policy workflow and mirror refs

source_documents.role: The audit identifies that the workflow compares origin/master without enforcing equality with deepseek-official/master.
The current workflow checks the custom delta against origin/master but does not fetch or compare the official remote.
The written fork topology requires local and fork master to mirror deepseek-official/master exactly.

findings.summary: The workflow invokes the policy verifier against origin/master but never fetches or proves equality between the fork mirror and deepseek-official/master.
findings.limitations: The current refs are equal, so the missing enforcement requires a mismatched-mirror fixture or isolated workflow probe to demonstrate rejection.

implementation_scope: Fetch the configured official remote in the workflow with full history before comparison.
Add an executable equality check that rejects origin/master or local master when it diverges from deepseek-official/master.
Keep the custom-delta attribution check against the mirror ref after equality succeeds.
Add positive matching and negative mismatched-mirror fixtures without requiring a network credential.
compatibility_obligations: Preserve the existing policy verifier as the owner of custom path attribution.
Avoid changing production package behavior or released Session data.
Make diagnostics identify the compared refs and the corrective fetch or merge action.
Keep fork and official remote URLs sourced from the policy record or workflow configuration rather than silently changing repository identity.

decision.result: AAA-017:A01 PASS — official-mirror equality gap reproduced and workflow-level correction specified
decision.diagnosis: The current clone happens to have equal mirror refs, but the workflow's only base argument is origin/master; a fork can therefore pass attribution while diverging from the official source. The next action needs workflow and verifier fixtures, not a product runtime change.
decision.next_action: Implement the official-remote fetch/equality check and matching/mismatched fixtures under the repository-automation owner.

commands: git diff --quiet master...origin/master; git diff --quiet origin/master...deepseek-official/master
rg -n -i official mirror/equality requirements across workflow, policy, and guide
